_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN; row S-19-OOC, the no-model half): out-of-character player lines in a group chat at an open stretch (v27-35-open-stretch.story.json, which declares player_turns_in_checkpoint). One in-character line, then '((...))', 'OOC: ...' and '(OOC) ...', each answered by a /sendas reply, then the control line 'I say (quietly) ...'. Asserts: player_turns_in_checkpoint counts the in-character line and the control only; a mocked read over the whole chat lists exactly the three OOC ids in audit.outOfCharacter, its prompt carries none of their text and does carry the control, a planted DELTA whose evidence is an OOC line is not accepted, and the journal's extraction row says '3 out-of-character lines not read'; a read whose window holds only OOC lines makes no model call (rawResponse NO_DELTA although a DELTA was planted) and stores nothing, and the boundary it commits still counts no turn. Left to the RP half and jest: the refusal streak and 'awaits the player' (runtime/stretchTurns.test.ts, engine/ooc.test.ts), the warden player_message, Continue/swipe/delete/reopen equality, and the byte-identical prompts of a chat without OOC lines (needs the payload golden diff). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-ooc-read.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const settle = async () => { await until(() => rt.getEngineState()?.lastMessageId === SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1, 15000, 'the newest message to commit a boundary'); await pause(400); }; const turns = () => rt.getEngineState()?.blackboard.values.player_turns_in_checkpoint ?? 0; const expectTurns = async (want) => { await settle(); if (turns() !== want) throw new Error('expected ' + want + ' player turn(s), read ' + turns()); return { turns: turns() }; }; const idsOf = (texts) => texts.map((text) => SillyTavern.getContext().chat.findIndex((message) => message.is_user && message.mes === text)); const audits = () => rt.extras.extraction.audits; globalThis.__ooc = { pause, until, settle, turns, expectTurns, idsOf, audits, lines: ['((brb, getting coffee))', 'OOC: can we skip to the walls?', '(OOC) is it raining in the story?'], control: 'I say (quietly) let us rest by the stream.' }; if (rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId !== 'road') throw new Error('the story did not start in the stretch'); return { active: 'road' };

steps.send: I walk on along the dusty road.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin Arin keeps pace beside you.

steps.send: OOC: can we skip to the walls?

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The fields roll on.

steps.send: (OOC) is it raining in the story?

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin Arin squints at a clear sky.

steps.send: I say (quietly) let us rest by the stream.

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin Arin nods and drops her pack.
